title: Cape Fear (TV series)
premise_summary: Cape Fear is an upcoming American thriller drama television miniseries created by Nick Antosca, based on the novel The Executioners by John D. MacDonald and its film adaptations in 1962 and 1991. It is produced by Eat the Cat, Universal Content Productions, and Amblin Television. It will premiere on June 5, 2026.
